execution_notes: Distinct invocations, targeted repairs and interrupted progress are reported separately; this is not one uninterrupted green execution.
Initial functional suite: 56 IDs, 10 pass and 46 errors: original policy-1 constraint rejected policy 2. Fixed with agent.0027.

Second functional suite: 63 IDs, 62 pass and one deliberately malformed fixture violated the new constraint. Fixture now switches both authorization mode and policy; targeted repair plus new inspector test pass.
Baseline initial invocation was intentionally stopped after 547 approved IDs and remaining IDs partitioned across independent databases.

Local PostgreSQL stopped accepting connections during initial process/regression invocations. Their errors/timeouts and teardown errors are retained; missing IDs are rerun on new local databases cloned from final schema.

The original baseline/B8C invocations began before agent.0027 was added; policy-1 coverage was retained. Remaining B7B/B8A coverage, B8D policy-2 tests, recovery invocations and final migration checks use the final schema.
ThreadPoolExecutor in process tests reads stdout only. Effects, locks, commits, human API transitions, SQL errors and killed workers use independent processes and actual PostgreSQL.

Closure 2026-09-25: initial recovery preflight blocked; the server then completed recovery naturally. A fresh local database was fully migrated; exactly 15 original missing IDs passed in 15 separate invocations. All original failures, interruptions and prior runs are retained. No runtime/test/fixture changes.

closure_acceptance.lock_evidence_note: Six original race01-race06 tests passed blocked(), which queries pg_stat_activity and requires Lock before releasing the first worker. External 50ms observer captured workers but no brief Lock windows; zero external samples is preserved, not presented as test assertion evidence.
closure_acceptance.subprocess_audit_limitation: Windows audit argv was a command string; the observer stored a character prefix rather than command arguments. Launch event counts are retained; worker identity is established by PostgreSQL application_name=b8a_<PID>, not that prefix.
